failure.interpretation: The dual-chain standard kernel accumulates group 0 and group 1 independently and combines them once. The already rejected pair kernel retains the original group-interleaved floating-point order. Their exact FP32 bits can therefore differ even when both remain inside the native-vs-generic numerical tolerance. The frozen v11 gate nevertheless required all legacy pair exactness assertions, so timing was prohibited.

performance.reason: The sequential correctness gate failed before timing. No zero or inferred speed score is assigned.

quality.reason: No production runtime or model candidate was created after the correctness-gate failure.

next_lane: Preregister a numerically tolerant v12 harness that keeps the native-vs-generic error bound, reports the pair-kernel delta instead of requiring bit identity, and retains frozen CUTE and MMLU gates before any model claim. The v11 performance hypothesis remains unobserved.
claim_boundary: v11 establishes only that reassociating CQ3 group accumulators changes at least one legacy pair-kernel FP32 bit pattern. It contains no candidate timing, model quality, storage, energy, 100 accepted tok/s, novelty, or breakthrough result.
